cohort: Patients with a singleton pregnancy who underwent cervical ripening with vaginal prostaglandin-E2
finding: Women who required cervical ripening with a Foley catheter after failing to respond to prostaglandin-E2 had a significantly higher risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women who failed to respond to prostaglandin-E2 for cervical ripening and required additional ripening with a Foley catheter had a significantly higher cesarean delivery rate.
